# Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps generally available

## What Changed

Enterprise Live Migrations (ELM) from Azure DevOps Services to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency is now generally available. You can move your repositories while your teams keep working, then…

## Why It Matters to a CSA

A generally available capability may remove a blocker or create an expansion opportunity.

## Customer Impact

**Medium**. Lifecycle: `ga`. Change type: `new`.

Confirm regional availability and evaluate it against active customer architectures.
